propositions: JiraConfig accepts non-https urls without validation, risking cleartext credential exposure in transit
DC ReconcilerConfig rejects non-https base_url via __post_init__ validation; Cloud JiraConfig has no equivalent __post_init__
Three consumers of load_config().jira silently swallow ConfigError exceptions, bypassing any JiraConfig-level rejection
write_jira_config persists Jira URL without scheme validation, allowing onboarding to write cleartext urls
JiraConfig must reject http:// urls at instantiation unless allow_insecure=True, with InsecureUrlError naming the risk and override key

resolve_jira_settings must fail-loud on non-https jira.url (raise InsecureUrlError before env fallback) to match DC fail-loud posture, while write_jira_config must validate before persist to prevent silent cleartext writes
